purpose: Compare signed changes in the graduated cup with the load on its support, and test whether software pulse timing varied between repeated trains.
scope: Pre-release wet rig after the straight tube ends were exchanged. A emptied the cup through the guided line and B filled the cup through the straight line.

paired_cup_round_trips.method: Subtract the first settled cup image from the last at each of the six matching printed-scale sightlines. The intermediate image cancels. The two middle LCD readings bracket the wait between trains.
paired_cup_round_trips.limits: The sightlines share glass, graduations and a surface fit. Their range measures agreement within these images. Each single-train practical allowance comes from the original optical reduction. Neither small net change has an independently established absolute error bound. One round trip gives opposing central signs on the cup and scale.

hold_after_repeat_b_r3.interpretation: Both camera images follow their corresponding LCD endpoint. No positive-duty command was recorded between them. One optical scale column gives a slight fall and the other a rise. Small syrup creep remains unresolved. The between-run display excursions exceed the changes during the two short zero-duty blanks.

software_gate_timing.selection: Every acknowledged positive-duty, multi-gate dose with a positive inter-gate pause in this pre-release archive. All used full motor duty and completed their requested count.
software_gate_timing.errors: Reported minus scheduled microseconds. For each train, scheduled on time is count times on_ms and the elapsed window includes count minus one pauses.
software_gate_timing.interpretation: Firmware brackets the gate with local clock reads after the enable and coast writes. It reports gate count, extrema, summed on time and the interval from the scheduled start through the final coast write. The logs contain no individual edge timestamps, physical PWM waveform, rotor position or fluid arrivals.

measurement_limits: The cup camera resolves the accumulated endpoint change. Dividing a train volume by its count gives a train mean. The rig jointly loads the scale with liquid, tubes and pump. Absolute liquid mass, density, a marginal-PWM start threshold, individual pulse volumes and rotor start delay require independent observations.
